## Emote names on cards, lighter cinematic fade

A small follow-up to the 1.4.0 redesign — one addition plus a few fixes from in-game feedback.

### Added

- **Emote command name on every card** — each card now shows the emote's raw rpemotes name in mono, so you can read it or type it directly with `/e`

### Fixes

- **Cinematic fade** — the edge fade was too dark and reached too far across the screen; it is now lighter and stops sooner, so much more of the game scene stays visible
- **Card layout** — on prop emotes the card sub-line could overlap the action icons; fixed (the redundant category word was dropped, the command name takes its place)
- **Active walk / expression banner** — was still using the pre-1.4 styling; it now matches the redesigned layout

### Install

Download `mbt_emote_menu.zip` below and drop it in your resources folder. Existing installs upgrade in place — favourites, recent list, wheel slots and custom lists are kept.

Requires [rpemotes-reborn](https://github.com/alberttheprince/rpemotes-reborn) latest.
